Database migrations with goose: on each generation, the change in the model since the last one becomes a migration file of yours in migrations/, which the migrate command (task migrate) applies.

```esquadro
blueprint migrations
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [postgres](../postgres/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [docker](../docker/) when the app uses them.

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `migrations.imports` | Imports of migrations/migrations.go. |
| `migrations.after` | Code in migrations.Apply after the model's migrations: the migrations of a blueprint's own tables (a job queue...). db is the *sql.DB and ctx the context; on failure it returns the error. It also runs on the tests' template database. |

## Hooks

- `pre-gen` write

## Go modules

- `github.com/pressly/goose/v3` v3.24.1
